question.en: When was Mahatma Gandhi born?
Which mountain(s) in Italy have the maximum elevation, and what are their IRIs, names and elevations?
Which city hosted the 2012 Summer Olympics and what was the main venue?
Which people are influenced by someone who was influenced by Mahatma Gandhi?
Which entities are headquartered in Mountain View, California?
Which entities are directly connected to Isaac Newton, either as people influenced by him or as entities that influenced him?
How many people have a nationality that is either German or French?
What are the notable works of A. A. Milne?

Which persons work in chemistry or physics, either by their field of work or by their occupation, have received at least one award, and are members of at least one organisation? Return each person together with their field, award, and organisation.
Which artist won the Grammy Award for Best Male Pop Vocal Performance in 1999, and what was the winning work?
Which persons do not have a recorded birth place in the dataset?
Which persons have received the highest number of awards? Return each person together with their award count and name.
How many people from each country have received both a Grammy Award and an Emmy Award?
Which pairs of awards have been received by the same person?

query.sparql:
PREFIX gptkbp: <https://gptkb.org/prop/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?a1 ?a2
WHERE {
  ?p gptkbp:awardReceived ?a1 .
  ?p gptkbp:awardReceived ?a2 .
  FILTER (STR(?a1) < STR(?a2))
}

question.en: Who won both the Academy Award for Best Director and the Golden Globe Award for Best Director?
Are there System Managers with problem solving ability?
Which persons were members of the National Academy of Sciences and received at least one award? Return each person together with their awards.
Who served the longest term as president of an institution? Return the person, the institution, and the length of their term.
Which operas have more than 1 librettist?

query.sparql:
PREFIX gptkb: <https://gptkb.org/entity/>
PREFIX gptkbp: <https://gptkb.org/prop/>

SELECT ?opera WHERE {
  ?opera gptkbp:librettist ?librettist .
}
GROUP BY ?opera
HAVING (COUNT(?librettist) > 1)

question.en: Who are the people that have been librettist for more than 7 operas?

query.sparql:
PREFIX gptkb: <https://gptkb.org/entity/>
PREFIX gptkbp: <https://gptkb.org/prop/>

SELECT ?librettist WHERE {
  ?opera gptkbp:librettist ?librettist .
}
GROUP BY ?librettist
HAVING (COUNT(?opera) > 7)

question.en: Give me any 5 people who were born in France.
Show me 5 notable employees of Bolt Beranek and Newman.

query.sparql:
PREFIX gptkb: <https://gptkb.org/entity/>
PREFIX gptkbp: <https://gptkb.org/prop/>
SELECT ?employee
WHERE {
  gptkb:Bolt_Beranek_and_Newman gptkbp:notableEmployee ?employee .
}
LIMIT 5

question.en: For each person, how many distinct organisations are they a member of?
List the five notable employees of Bolt Beranek and Newman ordered alphabetically by IRI.

query.sparql:
PREFIX gptkb: <https://gptkb.org/entity/>
PREFIX gptkbp: <https://gptkb.org/prop/>
SELECT ?employee
WHERE {
  gptkb:Bolt_Beranek_and_Newman gptkbp:notableEmployee ?employee .
}
ORDER BY ASC (?employee)
LIMIT 5
